title: StaticData
description: Schema for *.data.json artifacts (kind: static_data). A flat list of options an agency-side generic_template's JSONForms enum/oneOf can be populated from at runtime, e.g. tnsw/npqs/1-apply/importing_countries.data.json.

const.description: Value stored when this option is selected, e.g. a country code or commodity name.

title.description: Human-readable label shown for this option.
